verdict.rationale: Probes show a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and an Atlas-specific markdown rendering at docs.stripe.com/atlas.md (HTTP 200). Many Atlas doc pages are also served as .md files (signup.md, 83b-election.md, company-types.md, etc.), so an agent can be pointed at clean, agent-readable Atlas docs. The llms.txt is Stripe-wide and is not shown to index Atlas content specifically. missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers Atlas pages, first-party documentation of agent-oriented doc usage, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent consumption.
